expectations.text: Output has a valid SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter containing name and description
expectations.evidence: No SKILL.md was produced — output is extract_invoices.py, a standalone Python script, plus RUN_NOTES.md.

expectations.text: Defines a CSV output schema including vendor name, invoice number, amount due, and due date
expectations.evidence: Script docstring and columns cover vendor name, invoice number, amount due, due date, PO number, plus confidence/notes columns.

expectations.text: Explicitly handles invoices missing a PO number as a separate flagged/approval path, not silently dropped or silently paid
expectations.evidence: Produces invoices_needs_approval.csv as a filtered subset, plus a needs_manager_approval column; parse_po_number() with documented caveats about false negatives.

expectations.text: Does not invent unnecessary external connectors (HubSpot/Slack/etc.) for what is a local folder/file task
expectations.evidence: Script only touches local PDF libraries (PyMuPDF/pypdf/pdfplumber/pdftotext) and the filesystem — no external connectors.

expectations.text: Includes a validation step (e.g. every CSV row has required fields or is flagged)
expectations.evidence: Confidence scoring + low-confidence flagging present, verified by the agent against 5 synthetic test PDFs including a blank/scanned one.

expectations.text: Names at least one concrete failure mode (e.g. unreadable/scanned PDF, ambiguous vendor name)
expectations.evidence: Scanned/no-text PDF case explicitly handled ('enter manually' fallback) and tested.

expectations.text: No API keys, tokens, or credential values anywhere in the output
expectations.evidence: Pure local file processing; grep across output files found no credential-like values.
